name: 85338 · Goodyear, AZ
findings: ZIP 85338 (Goodyear) has 130 nonprofit organizations. 55 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 45 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 85338 (Goodyear) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
29% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 85338 (Goodyear) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 67% of the typical level).
